description: The ~200-record Fable+Gemini discovery output — prep/compile INPUT, not runtime. The catalog records carry ~20 varying fields, so v1 validates the ENVELOPE and the shape_is_new_backlog work items (the completeness-gating part), leaving catalog record internals permissive (widen to reality, plan §6).

counts.description: The discovery funnel. hallucinated_dropped MUST be 0 (the zero-hallucination bar) — asserted by the compile step, not this schema.

shape_is_new_backlog.description: Mandatory runner work (§4). Each is a gating work item, never a permanent flag.

fable_catalog.description: Verified primary records (~200). Item internals intentionally open in v1.
